historical_record.description: The Angler's Lodge was built in 1936.

The new fly-casting clubhouse and pools, built by the Works Progress Administration, were turned over to the city on the afternoon of Sunday, March 5, 1939, and placed under the Board of Park Commissioners.

The Board of Park Commissioners let the Golden Gate Angling and Casting Club use the new Anglers' Lodge beside the fly-casting pools west of the stadium as its headquarters, the club's old lodge on Stow Lake having lately been demolished; the club was to repair, paint and keep up the building.
